## Browser cache open timeout, 2026-09-22

LC-ARCH-011: a hung Turso driver import or `connect` must reject within the
bounded open wait, release the owner lock, abandon a late handle, and let the
browser wrapper continue with IndexedDB or memory. Focused Turso open tests
cover timeout, lock release, late-connect close, and store-open rejection.
Controller restore must not remain on an empty `restoring` shell because a
disposable cache opener never settled.

## Unified environment verification, 2026-09-12

LC-OPS-005 passes public configuration and cold Vite host/file-serving tests,
static fixture checks, specification/type checks, and the 448-test unit lane
(2 skipped). Both Docker auth contracts pass with Keytr storage on the actual
relay image; provider services and the PRF authenticator are disposable test
implementations. Projects Docker acceptance passes its one targeted contract
(42 other stories skipped). The packaged UI consumer passes six viewport/theme
cases. Storybook/package builds and the 13-plugin relay-to-site smoke pass.

The relay-owned canonical topology test also passes all 13 plugins, identical
repeat hydration, preservation of additional roles, restart persistence,
freshness-head history replay, and signed Keytr restoration after volume reset.

The aggregate `pnpm checks` run remains failed at Storybook: a browser
connection/RPC `createTesters` failure occurred after 320 passing assertions.
The separate Docker Storybook lane passed 53 assertions but reported an
unhandled `relay connection closed by us` rejection. These errors remain
unresolved; neither lane is recorded as passing overall.

Real Google/GitHub login, public-domain tunnel/CORS acceptance, and a physical
PRF authenticator smoke remain pending credentials and account access. The
relay-owned local Community runbook records activation and reset verification.

## Agent controls and participant picker follow-up, 2026-09-14

The main Community controller now forwards processing query/set actions to its
agent controller. A cold production-application fixture verifies encrypted
requests, pending Start/Stop transitions, and correlated acknowledgements. The
profile presents the same secondary icon-button treatment as Message and Follow,
with Start, Stop, and Refresh status in its menu. The gallery uses a secondary
button with a subtle border and shadow overlapping the avatar. Checking and
pending transitions show only the shared Spinner, with accessible action labels.
Processing badges use success, neutral, warning and danger backgrounds for
enabled, disabled or unknown, cancelling and failed states. Processing and gallery
operational errors use app toasts.

The editor composes the public member command inline, flush with its parent,
without outer padding or margins and with a scrollable list capped at 10rem.
Tests cover keyboard search
and selection, named removable selections, retained unknown keys, save rejection
and retry, and cancelling without changing the saved allowlist. Gallery and
profile consumers supply their current community members and controller search.

A fresh focused browser run passes all 63 affected stories in eight files,
including the public Dialog and Members pattern contracts, interaction,
accessibility, dark/narrow fixtures, profile action bounds, spinner-only pending
controls, state badge backgrounds, and compact participant-list geometry. Manual browser
inspection confirms the gallery overlap, profile action row, scrollable tabs,
and inline editor. Human visual-baseline approval remains pending.

The unit suite passes 514 tests with two existing skips. The Docker UI lane
passes 57 stories, and the project/forge lane passes its targeted integration
story (46 other stories are excluded by that lane's filter). The monolithic
`pnpm checks` passes format, specification, type, and unit checks, then loses its
browser connection after 351 passing Storybook tests. That aggregate command is
not green; full Storybook coverage was not completed in this follow-up. The
packaged consumer passes all six viewport/theme contracts. Final Storybook and
package builds pass, including publint; format, specification, UI, Svelte and
TypeScript checks also pass.

`pnpm local:agent` rebuilt, atomically installed, and restarted the local
controller. The installed executable matches the newly built executable, and
service status and doctor report the controller, agent, and managed host ready.
Read-only inspection of the existing signed-in local Community tab confirms
that both gallery and profile processing controls have settled on Stop, with
no active error toasts. The open editor has zero outer picker padding or
margins, aligned parent edges and a 160px list viewport. No live editor values
or processing state were changed during this inspection. Runtime configuration
fetching was not re-exercised in that open editor; correlated processing requests
and acknowledgements are covered by the production fixture.

The main Agents gallery no longer lists saved definitions as separate agents.
Unlinked definitions remain available through Add agent → Saved setups, with
Continue setup and confirmed Delete setup. Failed deletion is retained for retry
and reported through an app toast. The controller excludes configurations linked
to undiscoverable agents, and deletion refreshes all references before signing.
Agent edits ignore deleted instance references when deciding whether a shared
configuration needs a copy.

A cold browser run passes 35 affected stories, including saved-setup recovery,

configuration exclusion, offline gating, production application controls, and
shared Dialog and Confirmation contracts. The focused protocol/session/controller

tombstone rejection, missing profiles and live shared-definition preservation.
All 518 unit tests pass, with two existing skips; format, specification, UI,
Svelte and TypeScript checks pass.

Room views now acknowledge the last projected incoming event when their loaded
content end enters the visible viewport. Forum-topic receipts stay scoped to
that topic, cursors advance monotonically, manual room unread clears its thread
cursors, and anonymous public history has no personal unread badges. Sidebar
counts use CommunityChip's neutral, borderless `subtle` variant.

Focused validation passed 50 controller, projection, Inbox, and read-observer
tests, followed by seven cold production/contract stories. The final observer
navigation regression also passed separately. The full unit suite passed 522
tests with two existing skips, and format, specification, UI policy, Svelte, and
TypeScript checks passed. The aggregate browser run reached 372 passing tests
across 59 files before its connection closed while starting
`Community/Patterns/Avatar`; `pnpm checks` is therefore not green. The focused
runs do not establish that the aggregate failure is unrelated.

The live local page was inspected, but a reload to verify the final change was
blocked by an open browser extension panel. No signing or relay publication was
required. Changed stories remain `visual-pending`; visual baseline approval is
